notes.overview: A very short (~3.5 km), ultra-fast layout with lap times near 55s in F1 and roughly 74-80% of the lap at full throttle. It shares Bahrain's right/left/right T1-T3 opening, then runs a fast outer loop of near-flat kinks broken by one medium chicane, before a double-right final complex feeds the 1.12 km main straight. Only a few real braking zones (T1, the chicane, the final complex); everything else is minimal-input and high-speed. Nail the final exit for your biggest gain.

corners.1: Heavy braking at the end of the main straight into a sharp right. Get the slowing done in a straight line, hit the apex, and protect the exit for the short run to T2.
corners.2: Quick left kink, effectively flat or a light lift. Minimal steering, keep the car settled, and set up on the right for T3.
corners.3: Right-hander closing the opening complex. Medium speed, so smooth entry and don't over-slow; carry momentum onto the run toward T4.
corners.4: Fast right that opens onto the top section with a wide exit. Light brake or lift only; use the full exit road and stay committed as it feeds the T5 kink.
corners.5: Left kink onto the outer loop, taken flat. Minimal input, hold your line, and keep the throttle pinned.
corners.6: Flat-out right on the fast outer loop. Barely a lift; commit, stay smooth, and avoid unsettling the car before the chicane.
corners.7: Entry to the medium-speed left/right chicane. Brake in a straight line, take a tidy left, and sacrifice it slightly to square up the T8 right.
corners.8: Right half of the chicane. Rotate and straighten the car early, then get hard on throttle; this exit feeds the return straight.
corners.9: Fast right kink onto the return straight. Light lift at most, hold a tight line, and stay committed toward the final complex.
corners.10: Braking zone into the double-right final complex. Slow in a straight line, take a patient entry, and don't apex early; the T11 exit is what matters.
corners.11: Final right onto the 1.12 km main straight. Get the car straight and back to full throttle as early as possible; this exit sets your speed down the longest straight on the lap.

notes.source: the-race.com (Bahrain Outer 'wacky' race explainer), f1-fansite.com Bahrain Outer Track layout/lap records, formula1.com Sakhir outer track article. No credible GT3/LMP2/Hypercar times were found for this specific layout, so reference_times left empty (F1's 55.404/53.377 are not LMU classes).
